supersession.supersedes_scope: selected-subset adjacency and candidate-reference-domain compatibility semantics only
supersession.rule: V3 supersedes v2 only where v2 permits partial candidate/reference-domain overlap as compatible or could be read to permit an adjacency condition on S_i. Every other v2 interval, documentary-source, output-validity, metric, and prohibition rule remains in force; every non-superseded v1 study-design rule remains in force. V1 and v2 bytes are preserved.

canonicalization.serialization: UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted lexicographically and separators ',' and ':'
canonicalization.hash_scope: the complete decoded JSON object after removing only the top-level contract_sha256 field

C_i.definition: C_i remains the frozen complete unordered collection of positive-width canonical candidate intervals from one candidate manifest and candidate-set digest.
C_i.partition_requirement: Within every declared candidate civil-day domain, the complete C_i intervals form the canonical gap-free, non-overlapping partition required by the preserved candidate-set contract.
C_i.partition_scope: C_i completeness and within-declared-domain partition validation apply to candidate construction, not to the geometry of a selected S_i subset.
preserved_rules: every interval is a positive-width half-open interval [start_utc, end_utc)
every interval retains its exact candidate manifest, candidate-set, interval, endpoint, civil-date, provenance, and full-state identity fields
no qualifying candidate interval is omitted or merged across a full-state change
within each declared civil-day domain C_i has no overlap or gap

D_i.definition: D_i is exactly the set union of all unchanged half-open intervals in C_i across every declared candidate date.
D_i.no_convex_hull_rule: D_i is not the convex hull or bounding interval of C_i; gaps between declared candidate-date domains remain outside D_i.
D_i.mutation_prohibited: Neither compatibility classification nor evaluation may fill a D_i gap, expand, clip, intersect, or otherwise mutate C_i.

S_i_candidate_subset.definition: A non-abstaining S_i is any nonempty unordered subset of exact unchanged whole interval records from C_i.
S_i_candidate_subset.allowed_geometry: S_i may contain disconnected intervals, including nonadjacent intervals on the same civil date and intervals separated by one or more unselected C_i members.
S_i_candidate_subset.adjacency_rule: Temporal adjacency, contiguity, one-window shape, and within-date connectivity are not validity conditions for the generic S_i candidate_subset output.
S_i_candidate_subset.distinct_from_C_i_partition: C_i must still pass complete within-date partition validation. That candidate-domain requirement does not require S_i to be complete, gap-free, adjacent, contiguous, or connected.
S_i_candidate_subset.ordering_rule: Input order has no ranking semantics. After duplicate and exact-membership validation, canonical reordering of the same members produces the same semantic commitment and receipt.
validation_requirements: exact complete-record membership in frozen C_i
no duplicate interval ID or complete identity
no changed endpoint or partial interval
no manufactured union, split, interpolation, or spanning window
no foreign candidate manifest, candidate set, civil domain, provenance, or full-state identity
no overlap beyond overlap already present in canonical C_i
S_i_candidate_subset.future_window_boundary: A contiguous-window or best-window output type would be a separate method and product decision and is not authorized by this contract.

abstention.rule: Explicit abstention remains distinct from candidate_subset and carries selected_intervals equal to an empty list.
abstention.interpretation: Abstention is neither success nor error and is not inferred from an invalid or empty candidate_subset.

reference_domain_compatibility_v3.precondition: Classify only an operative positive-width canonical half-open T_i after documentary eligibility, source-lineage adjudication, precision preservation, and canonicalization pass.
reference_domain_compatibility_v3.intersection_measure: Let overlap_width be the summed positive elapsed width of T_i intersected with the exact union D_i. Endpoint-only contact contributes zero width.

states.condition: T_i is a subset of D_i; equivalently, every coordinate of T_i is covered by the union of C_i intervals and no positive-width part of T_i lies outside D_i.
overlap_width is positive and T_i is not a subset of D_i.
overlap_width is zero, including wholly disjoint intervals and endpoint-only contact.

reference_domain_compatibility_v3.full_containment_across_boundaries: T_i may be compatible while spanning two or more adjacent C_i intervals because D_i is their set union; a canonical interval boundary inside T_i does not create a domain defect.
reference_domain_compatibility_v3.partial_or_complete_incompatibility_rule: For reference_domain_partially_incompatible or reference_domain_incompatible, issue no valid reference-accuracy result or valid reference-evaluation receipt. Reference intersection is the typed not-applicable status for that state, never true or false. Give the method neither credit nor error.
reference_domain_compatibility_v3.immutability_rule: Never clip T_i to D_i, replace T_i by its intersection, expand D_i, fill a candidate-domain gap, or modify any C_i or T_i endpoint to change the classification.

diagnostics.documentary_width_rule: Retain the complete unchanged T_i width when an operative T_i exists; the width is a documentary-precision diagnostic, not credit, error, coverage, probability, confidence, or an accuracy result.

reference_intersection.applicable_condition: A valid nonempty nonabstaining S_i and reference_domain_compatible operative T_i.
reference_intersection.true_condition: At least one exact selected half-open interval has a positive-width intersection with T_i.
reference_intersection.false_condition: The reference domain is compatible but no selected interval has a positive-width intersection with T_i.
reference_intersection.endpoint_touch_rule: Endpoint-only contact is not an intersection.

retained_components_for_disconnected_S_i.temporal_width: Sum only the widths of exact selected S_i members; never fill unselected gaps.
retained_components_for_disconnected_S_i.canonical_interval_count: Count exact selected interval records, whether or not adjacent.
retained_components_for_disconnected_S_i.unique_full_state_count: Count distinct selected full_state_sha256 values independently of interval adjacency and interval count.
retained_components_for_disconnected_S_i.date_coverage: Count only declared dates represented by at least one selected member; an unselected intervening date or interval remains excluded.

acceptance_edge_cases.setup: One synthetic date has four canonical C_i intervals; S_i contains only the first and third.
acceptance_edge_cases.expected_temporal_width: sum of first and third interval widths only
acceptance_edge_cases.expected_unique_state_count: distinct full-state identities represented by the first and third intervals

acceptance_edge_cases.setup: The same disconnected exact members are supplied in reverse order.
acceptance_edge_cases.expected_commitment: identical to canonical commitment for the original ordering

acceptance_edge_cases.setup: One selected exact member appears twice.
One manufactured interval spans the first through third intervals and fills the unselected gap.
C_i contains more than one declared date and T_i is wholly contained in D_i on an included date.
C_i contains more than one declared date and T_i lies on a date absent from D_i.

implementation_boundary.authorized_work: content-hashed metric/reference-domain policy, documentation, audit, and structural tests only
